title: Basic leucine zipper ATF-like transcription factor (BATF) as a candidate marker associated with venous thromboembolism risk factors in sepsis: an integrated bioinformatics and machine learning analysi
summary: Full primary text shows transcriptomic ML and cohort analyses nominate BATF, with ROC/Cox associations across datasets; authors explicitly state no adjudicated or imaging-confirmed VTE outcome was studied. Candidate biomarker signal only, not diagnosis or direct thrombosis prediction.
ai_technology: Transcriptomic machine learning and cross-cohort expression analyses nominated BATF as a candidate signal associated with VTE risk factors in sepsis.
